paper_id: Object-oriented backdoor attack against image captioning
title: Object-oriented backdoor attack against image captioning
motivation: Backdoor attacks on image classification are well-studied, but vision-language models remain largely unexplored for this threat
problem_framing: Define backdoor attack for image captioning with dual goals: stealthiness (comparable BLEU on clean images) and effectiveness (high ASR on poisoned images)
key_insight: Captions revolve around objects, so poisoning object regions with sample-specific triggers yields more natural visual effects than uniform patches
method_signature: Object-oriented poisoning using YOLO detection + Gaussian noise injection (α=20) on detected object regions
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Object detector limitation causes some objects not to be detected; future work plans semantic segmentation for more precise region targeting
evidence_for_taste: captions are usually unfolded around objects
limiting the FTR to no more than 5%
thinking_moves: 将caption生成问题重新frame为backdoor攻击问题
从视觉领域(图像分类)的backdoor攻击迁移到跨模态任务
利用caption围绕objects的特点设计sample-specific triggers
通过视觉对比(Fig 2)而非数值指标证明方法优越性
